Experiment design and causal judgment. Domain knowledge and rigor determine whether confounding exists beyond an A/B test and whether causal inference is valid.
Accountability and sign-off. Someone must answer for model bias, compliance, and consequences after deployment. AI does not accept liability.
Cross-functional communication and business coordination. People still translate model findings into business language.
Strategic decisions and trust building. At chief data officer or advisory levels, trust and perspective matter most.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: The score measures how much daily work is standardized and reproducible by algorithms. Data science scores 8/10, relatively high, because cleaning, baseline modeling, and visualization are highly rule-based and readily exposed to AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A score of 8/10 does not mean the occupation is close to disappearing. Highly exposed careers receive efficiency gains early and also create new roles, including ML platform engineering and responsible AI.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Data science remains worth studying, but the learning path must change. Combine a statistics or CS master's degree with engineering and business knowledge instead of learning only to call packages. Employers increasingly require AI collaboration and production engineering. Career-interest and ability assessments can help identify the right data path.

Path A: ML platform / MLOps, where demand grows around deployment. Path B: decision science / business insight, closer to strategy. Path C: responsible AI / governance, where compliance and interpretability provide defensibility. Compare AI data tools for the details.

Do not write only proficient in Python. Explain which business problem you solved with data and how much a metric improved. Show the full path from problem definition to deployment. Turn tool use into evidence of delivered results.

Hiring standards are shifting from algorithm familiarity toward clear problem framing, reliable engineering, and accountability. Compare adjacent-career skill models with high-replacement-risk clerical roles. A standardized data-role capability assessment can support screening.

ai_s7_trends: Generative AI enters the full analytics workflow. NL2SQL, automated exploration, and code generation lower the entry barrier, allowing people to focus on questions and design.
MLOps and real-time inference become common. Models move from offline experiments to online services, making engineering ability a major dividing line.
Responsible AI and data governance expand. Bias, privacy, interpretability, and compliance create new role boundaries and broaden the scope of data science.

body: Data scientists do more than run models or write SQL. They define problems, acquire and clean data, build statistical and machine-learning models, design experiments, and interpret results so organizations can turn data into action.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Tools such as GitHub Copilot and NotebookLM have accelerated coding and exploration for Data scientists severalfold. BLS still projects 34% growth from 2024 to 2034. The role itself is not disappearing; people limited to mechanical use of packages face the pressure.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: GitHub Copilot 与 NotebookLM 类工具已把数据科学家的编码与探索提速数倍，但 2024–2034 年 BLS 预计该职业增长 34%——被淘汰的从来不是"数据科学家"这个岗位，而是只会机械调包的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年数据科学家在岗约 24.59 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 32.83 万人，净增约 8.24 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.34 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 11.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代数据科学家岗位，但会大幅接管其中的重复性任务。 这个职业的需求高速增长，BLS 预计 2024–2034 年就业增长 34% 。真正被压缩的是"样板清洗、基线建模、重复可视化"这类动作，不是"问题定义、实验设计、解释担责"这类能力。
ai_s2_accel: 实验设计与因果推断 ：人定义假设与识别混淆。
模型审查与可解释性 ：用模型解释偏差与业务含义。
数据治理与质量 ：定义口径、血缘与合规边界。
业务翻译 ：把结论变成可执行的决策。
ai_s2_auto: 样板数据清洗 ：缺失值、类型转换、重复项处理可由工具自动完成。
基线建模 ：自动特征工程与 AutoML 给出可比较的基线。
代码生成 ：Copilot 类助手加速 SQL、Python 与 notebook 编写。
报表与看板 ：自然语言生成初步图表与摘要。
ai_s3_list: 问题定义与指标设计 。业务要回答什么、用什么指标衡量，规则给不了唯一答案。AI 能列选项，最终拍板的还是人。
实验设计与因果判断 。A/B 之外是否有混淆、是否可因果推断，需要领域知识与严谨。
责任与签字担责 。模型上线要有人对偏差、合规与后果负责。AI 不背锅。
跨部门沟通与业务协同 。把模型结论翻译成业务语言，还得靠人。
战略决策与信任构建 。到了首席数据官、顾问层，拼的是信任与格局。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 打分逻辑：它衡量职业的日常任务有多少是标准化、可被算法复制的。数据科学得分 8/10，因为清洗、基线建模、可视化这些核心动作恰好高度规则化——所以 AI 一冲就进来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 8/10 不代表"快被淘汰"。恰恰相反：高曝光的职业最先吃到效率红利，也最先催生新岗位（如 ML 平台工程、负责任 AI）。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 数据科学仍值得读，但读法要变：冲统计/CS 硕士 + 工程与业务双修，而非只学调包。；企业招聘对 AI 协同与工程化能力要求持续上升。提前看清适合哪条数据线，可做 职业兴趣与能力测评 。
路径 A：ML 平台 / MLOps——需求上升，承接模型上线。；路径 B：决策科学 / 业务洞察——靠近战略。；路径 C：负责任 AI / 治理——合规与可解释性是护城河。详见 AI 数据工具横评 。
别只写"熟练 Python"。写清你用数据解决过什么业务问题、提升过多少指标。；展示从定义问题到上线的完整闭环。把"会用工具"变成"用工具交付了结果"。
标准从"算法熟"转向"问题清、工程稳、能担责"。；参考相邻职业的能力模型，对照高替代风险的文员岗。需要标准化筛人，可用 数据岗能力模型测评 。

ai_s7_trends: 一是生成式 AI 进数据分析全流程。 NL2SQL、自动探索与代码生成让分析门槛下降，人聚焦问题与设计。
二是 MLOps 与实时推理普及。 模型从离线实验走向在线服务，工程化能力成为分水岭。
三是负责任 AI 与数据治理兴起。 偏见、隐私、可解释与合规成为岗位新边界，数据科学的范围只会更宽。

body: 数据科学家不是简单"跑模型"或"写 SQL"。它是一类围绕问题定义、数据获取与清洗、统计与机器学习建模、实验设计与结果解释，帮助组织把数据变成可行动决策的职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: GitHub Copilot 与 NotebookLM 类工具已把数据科学家的编码与探索提速数倍，但 2024–2034 年 BLS 预计该职业增长 34%——被淘汰的从来不是"数据科学家"这个岗位，而是只会机械调包的人。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can review months of surveillance footage overnight, but an investigator still has to sit in the interview room and ask a suspect to think again.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 117,900 Detectives And Criminal Investigators were employed in 2024, declining to a projected 117,100 by 2034. That represents about 800 fewer jobs and roughly 7,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $93,600 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Detectives And Criminal Investigators, but it will transform how they find leads. Video matching and facial recognition can locate a person quickly, while data-analysis tools map financial activity that once required days of ledger review. Interviews, interrogations, and evidence-chain judgment remain human work. AI can flag suspicion, but investigators must explain why and obtain lawful evidence.
ai_s2_accel: Data-analysis platforms: automated modeling and visualization of financial and communication networks
AI interview support: flags contradictions in statements
Predictive policing: analyzes crime hotspots to inform deployment
Digital scene twins: 3D reconstruction supports crime-scene analysis
ai_s2_auto: Surveillance-video search: AI matches targets across large video archives
Face and license-plate recognition: automated matching and alerts for persons of interest
Digital forensics tools: rapid extraction and analysis of phone and computer data
Digital case files and statements: OCR, keyword search, and workflow management
ai_s3_list: Interviews and trust: honest witness cooperation depends on communication and confidence.
Interrogation and psychology: machines cannot readily expose or document a carefully fabricated account.
Whole-chain evidence judgment: investigators assess completeness and legal admissibility.
Scene intuition and experience: trained investigators notice hidden evidence and unusual details.
Discretion and humane enforcement: victims and juvenile suspects require human care and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places Detectives And Criminal Investigators in the moderate AI exposure range. AI speeds search, matching, and organization, while interviews, interrogation, and evidence-chain decisions remain primarily human.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. Stronger AI increases the need for investigators who understand law, analyze evidence, and act in the field. Tools can identify a suspicious person, but people must establish why and build a lawful case. Low-level work based only on errands faces pressure, while investigators combining legal and data skills become scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Police-academy, law, or criminal-investigation study can provide a foundation. Add data analysis, digital forensics, criminal law, and evidence law. Learn recruitment, background-screening, physical, and psychological requirements early.

Develop digital forensics and data-analysis skills rather than relying only on paper files and field visits. Combine AI-assisted analysis with strong interviewing and witness-contact skills to progress from frontline investigator to specialist.

Public-law-enforcement roles require formal recruitment examinations and a lengthy selection process. Private investigation or internal corporate risk roles offer adjacent experience. Résumés should describe measurable case outcomes without exposing confidential information.
Do not recruit investigators by education alone. Evaluate data capability, interviewing experience, legal knowledge, responsible use of AI tools, and resilience under pressure.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Large-scale video search, target matching, and movement tracking
Phone and computer forensics and deleted-data recovery
Matching and alerting for persons of interest
Models and visualizes financial flows and communication networks
Case registration, progress tracking, and file management
Three-dimensional modeling supports analysis of event sequences

ai_s7_trends: Cybercrime, telecommunications fraud, and financial crime remain prevalent, making digital forensics and data analysis standard investigative skills.
AI turns large-scale search and matching into rapid work, letting investigators focus on interviews, evidence chains, and legal judgment.
Predictive policing and digital forensics are becoming routine, while stricter admissibility and ethical rules raise the importance of legal literacy.

body: Detectives And Criminal Investigators collect and analyze crime leads, examine scenes and physical evidence, interview witnesses, and question suspects. They build evidence chains and refer cases to prosecutors as core operational participants in criminal justice.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能在一晚上刷完几个月的监控，但审讯室里那句「你再想想」，还得调查员亲自说出口。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年侦探刑事调查员在岗约 11.79 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 11.71 万人，岗位净减约 0.08 万个，年均产生约 0.78 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.36 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代侦探和刑事调查员，但会大幅改变「找线索」的方式。以前查一个案子的监控要几个人看几天，现在 AI 视频比对、人脸识别能快速锁定目标；以前翻纸质账本查资金流向，现在数据研判工具一键出图。但走访、审讯、证据链判断这些核心，还得靠人——AI 告诉你「他可疑」，但为什么可疑、怎么问出来，是人的活。
ai_s2_accel: 数据研判平台：资金流、通讯关系自动建模可视化
AI 话术与审讯辅助：识别证词矛盾点提示
预测性警务：犯罪热点分析辅助布警
数字孪生现场：3D 重建案发现场辅助推演
ai_s2_auto: 监控视频检索：AI 自动比对目标，从海量录像中快速定位
人脸与车牌识别：重点人员自动比对预警
电子取证工具：手机、电脑数据一键提取分析
案卷与笔录电子化：OCR 识别、关键词检索、流程管理
ai_s3_list: 走访与信任建立：证人愿不愿意跟你说实话，靠的是沟通技巧和信任。
审讯与心理博弈：面对精心编造的供述，怎么拆穿、怎么固定口供，机器替代不了。
证据链的全局判断：证据能不能形成闭环、有没有合法性问题，是法律判断。
现场直觉与经验：哪个角落藏着物证、哪个细节反常，经验就是优势。
执法中的裁量与人文关怀：对受害者的安抚、对未成年嫌疑人的处理，需要人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半任务在桌面完成——检索、比对、整理这些正被 AI 大幅加速，但走访、审讯、证据链判断这些核心环节，AI 只能辅助。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，越需要懂法律、会研判、能落地的调查员去把关——它帮你筛出可疑对象，但「为什么是他、怎么定罪」要人拍板。真正被冲击的是纯靠体力跑腿、不碰数据和法律的低端侦查，复合型侦查人才反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走警校或法学、侦查学专业，重点补数据分析、电子取证和刑法证据法。AI 时代，会数据研判的侦查员非常吃香。公务员招录和政审要提前了解，身体素质和心理抗压也别落下。
把电子取证、数据研判工具补起来，别停留在「翻案卷、跑现场」。学会用 AI 工具辅助研判，再保持审讯和走访的手艺，才能从基层侦查员升级为专家型侦查员。
执法系统要走招录考试，门槛高、周期长；也可先考虑私人调查公司或企业内部风控调查岗积累经验。简历上多写「独立侦办案件数、移送起诉率」这类可量化成果。
招调查员别只看学历，要看数据能力和审讯经验。能同时懂法律、会用 AI 研判工具、扛得住高压的候选人，比单维度能力强的人更值得投入。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 海量视频检索、目标比对、轨迹追踪
手机/电脑取证、恢复删除数据
重点人员比对、预警推送
资金流、通讯关系建模可视化
案件登记、进度追踪、卷宗管理
三维建模辅助推演案发过程
矛盾点识别、供述一致性校验
犯罪热点预测、警力调度建议

ai_s7_trends: 网络犯罪、电信诈骗、经济犯罪持续高发，电子取证与数据研判成为侦查标配，懂技术的侦查员需求上升。
AI 让海量检索和比对从「人海战术」变为「一键完成」，侦查员把精力转向审讯、证据链与法律判断。
预测性警务与数字取证常态化，但证据合法性与伦理规范同步收紧，法律素养成为硬门槛。

body: 侦探与刑事调查员负责收集与分析犯罪线索、开展现场勘查与证物整理、走访证人并进行审讯，最终构建证据链并向检察机关移送案件，是刑事司法体系的核心执行角色。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can flag a suspicious lesion, but only a sonographer's hand can reveal a deep structure in a blurred view.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 90,000 Diagnostic medical sonographers were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 101,700 by 2034. That represents about 11,700 additional jobs and roughly 5,800 openings per year. Median annual pay was about $89,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Diagnostic medical sonographers, but it will take over standardized measurements and initial screening. AI-assisted detection, automated measurements, and draft reports reduce time spent recording data. Probe technique, image optimization, and judgment in difficult cases remain human strengths that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI image enhancement for difficult cases
Automated follow-up and examination-data archiving
Remote consultation and image-sharing platforms
Positioning assistance for ultrasound-guided interventions
ai_s2_auto: Automated measurement and labeling of standard views
AI-assisted detection of common lesion areas
Automated draft reports and measurement data
Systematic management of examination workflows and schedules
ai_s3_list: Probe technique: a different scanning angle can produce a completely different image of the same area.
Image optimization and artifact recognition: sonographers distinguish a technique problem from a pathological finding when images blur or overlap.
Real-time observation and adaptation: patient movement or breath-holding changes the view, so probe control must respond immediately.
Judgment in difficult cases: atypical images that AI does not flag require anatomical knowledge and experience.
Communication with patients and physicians: calm anxious patients, explain the procedure, and accurately convey observations.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places Diagnostic medical sonographers in the low-moderate AI exposure range. Measurement and standardized acquisition account for a meaningful share of the work and are increasingly automated.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high replacement risk. Stronger AI increases demand for people who acquire accurate images, understand what they see, and verify results. Roles limited to routine scanning face pressure, while sonographers skilled in difficult cases and multiple specialties become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Medical imaging technology offers a technical route into hospital work. Build a strong foundation in anatomy and practice probe technique during clinical training. Study difficult cases and discuss findings with physicians instead of learning only routine scanning.

Treat AI assistance as a second set of eyes and learn to verify its markings. Develop expertise in obstetric, cardiac, or vascular sonography. Working across multiple approved practice sites can also expand earning potential.

Sonography requires formal medical imaging education and certification. People with clinical or nursing backgrounds have useful experience. Résumés should quantify independently completed scans and detected cases where confidentiality permits.

Do not hire Diagnostic medical sonographers based on certificates alone. A live scan of a difficult view reveals probe skill. Candidates who combine technique, judgment, and effective communication merit long-term development.

ai_s7_trends: AI takes over standardized measurements and initial screening, shifting sonographers toward technique quality control and difficult-case judgment.
Wider use of ultrasound and expanded health screening increase demand in obstetric, cardiovascular, and other specialties.
Multi-site practice and remote consultation become routine, creating a clear premium for sonographers with strong specialty skills.

body: Diagnostic medical sonographers operate ultrasound equipment and use standardized scanning techniques to capture images of body structures. They take measurements, optimize images, and work with physicians on preliminary interpretation and report preparation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动标出可疑的病灶区域，但那个位置藏得深、图像又糊的切面，只有超声诊断师的手能把它「逼」出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年医学超声诊断师在岗约 9.00 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.17 万人，净增约 1.17 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.58 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 8.93 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代医学超声诊断师，但会接管标准化测量与初筛。AI 辅助识别、自动测量、报告初稿，正在把诊断师从「量数据」里解放出来。剩下的探头手法、图像优化、疑难判断，是人的核心，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 图像增强辅助疑难病例
自动随访与检查数据归档
远程会诊与图像共享平台
超声引导介入的定位辅助
ai_s2_auto: 标准切面的自动测量与标注
AI 辅助识别常见病灶区域
报告初稿与测量数据自动生成
检查流程与排班的系统化管理
ai_s3_list: 探头手法：同一部位，扫查角度不同，图像天差地别。
图像优化与伪影识别：糊了、重影了，能判断是手法问题还是病理问题。
实时观察与应变：病人一动、呼吸一屏，切面就变了，手上要跟上。
疑难判断：AI 标不出的非典型图像，靠的是解剖功底和经验。
与病人和医师的沟通：安抚紧张、讲清流程、准确传达所见。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的测量、标准化采集比重不小，这些正被 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 越强，越需要「扫得准、看得懂」的人去验证它的结果。真正被挤压的是「只会按流程扫、不动脑判断」的岗位，会疑难判断、懂多专项的超声诊断师反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医学影像技术是进医院的技术型好赛道。读专业时把解剖学学扎实，实习时多练手法；AI 时代别只学「按流程扫」，要多看疑难病例、多跟医师讨论。

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can produce one hundred standard lenses with one click, but only an experienced technician can work at the beveling bench until discovering why a customer with high astigmatism still feels dizzy.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代眼科技工室技术员这个岗位，但会吃掉流程里最机械的部分：自动磨边、数字化加工、AI 质检正在让「按单磨片」的工作快速变薄。留下来的价值在于特殊镜片的手工精修、异常判断和最终质量把关——机器磨得又快又准，但「这单为什么磨出来不对」得靠人想清楚。
ai_s2_accel: 自由曲面设计软件自动计算渐进片优化曲线
机器视觉辅助镜片装配对位与轴位校准
3D 扫描与打印技术进入定制镜框制造
设备互联让加工参数与质检结果实时联动
ai_s2_auto: 自动磨边机按处方一键设定磨片参数

ai_s3_list: 特殊镜片手工精修：高散光、渐进片的边缘手感。

精细质检：机器标「合格」的数据之外，靠眼和手确认佩戴体验。
设备调试与维护：自动化设备越普及，会调会修的人越值钱。
沟通与返工管理：跟验光师、门店把需求对齐，把返工率压下去。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业正处在「自动化快速渗透」的中间地带：标准镜片加工几乎全流程可自动化，但定制化、异常处理和手工精修环节仍需人手，岗位整体不会消失，而是从「操作工」向「技师+质检」转型。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中风险不等于没出路：会用自动化设备、懂质检标准、能处理特殊镜片的技师反而更抢手。纯手工按单磨片的路会越走越窄，往设备调试、质量控制和技术管理走才是正解。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这行，优先选眼视光技术、眼镜定配相关专业，职校阶段就多进实训车间练手。把自动化设备操作和质检标准当必修课，别只练手工磨片。
把自由曲面加工、自动化磨边、AI 质检这些新设备吃透，往技师、质检、生产管理方向升级。手工功底保留住，它仍是处理特殊镜片的护城河。
转行门槛不高：从眼镜店加工岗或验配中心学徒起步，先把验光单读懂、把磨边装配跑熟，再考定配工资格。面试时多展示你对精度和细节的把控。
招聘时把「会操作自动化设备 + 懂手工精修 + 有质检意识」作为组合要求，给技师保留手工环节的价值评价，避免把岗位压缩成纯操作工。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace vegetation pesticide applicators, but it will reduce standardized roles. Emphasize certification and plot experience, and specify the vegetation types you have treated. Landscaping employers value reliability and compliance.
When hiring, assess more than physical fitness; look for sound compliance judgment. Core workers who can handle complex terrain deserve higher rates.

Mixture preparation and protection create opportunities.
People with judgment and compliance skills are more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically interpret remote sensing images and generate prescription maps with one click, but when equipment fails, you still need to be the person crouching in the field to repair it.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,600 precision agriculture technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 19,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with about 2,900 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $46,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace precision agriculture technicians, but it will change how they work. AI and software are taking over remote sensing interpretation, prescription map generation, and data reports, shifting technicians from map producers to implementers and solution advisers. Equipment installation and commissioning, field calibration, and communication with farmers cannot be replaced by machines. Technicians who understand data and can repair equipment will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted diagnosis of pests, diseases, and weeds
Wider use of autonomous drone field scouting and variable-rate spraying
Real-time data transmission from soil sensor networks
Large language model assistance in generating fertilization and pesticide application plans
ai_s2_auto: Automated interpretation of remote sensing imagery and crop growth analysis
One-click algorithmic generation of prescription maps
Digital data reports and records
Automatic upload of equipment positioning and operation records
ai_s3_list: Field equipment commissioning: RTK setup, signal calibration, and on-site troubleshooting.
Agronomic judgment: even an accurate prescription map must be assessed alongside soil fertility and the farming calendar.
Communication and trust with farmers: solutions are implemented only when the technology is explained clearly and accepted.
Response to unexpected situations: people handle equipment failures and sudden weather changes in the field.
Connecting data with production: even the best map must be validated in the field.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 means more than half of this occupation's desk-based tasks are being automated. AI and software can assist with image interpretation, prescription generation, and report preparation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over map production, leaving implementation, including equipment installation, field calibration, and farmer service, even more important. Pure data-processing jobs are being reduced, while technicians who can repair equipment and work in the field are more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Choose a major in agronomy, remote sensing, geographic information, or mechatronics. Participate in drone and GIS competitions, and intern with agricultural service or machinery companies during breaks to develop both equipment and software skills.

Become proficient with drones, GIS, and AI tools, and proactively take on solution design and farmer training. Advance from installing equipment to integrating equipment, data, and agronomy, and earn a drone pilot license and surveying certificates.

A background in remote sensing, GIS, or mechatronics is ideal, but people without one can start as equipment installation assistants. On your resume, specify the systems you installed, the number of flights you completed, and the prescription maps you produced.

When hiring technicians, look beyond certificates to willingness to work in the field and service ability. Candidates who can repair equipment, visit fields, and clearly explain solutions to farmers offer the rarest combination.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Real-time soil moisture and nutrient monitoring
Automated identification of pests, diseases, and crop growth
Integration of weather, soil, and operation data
Work orders, training, and service records

ai_s7_trends: As AI interpretation and prescription generation become widespread, technicians are shifting from map production to equipment implementation and solution consulting, with data analysis becoming a foundational skill.

High-standard farmland and smart agriculture policies are driving equipment demand. Versatile technicians who can install equipment, understand agronomy, and provide service are increasingly sought after.
As agricultural service companies expand, technicians are moving into hybrid roles such as regional service manager and solutions engineer.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年精准农业技术员在岗约 1.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.94 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代精准农业技术员，但会改变工作方式。遥感解译、处方图生成、数据报表正被 AI 和软件接管，技术员从「出图员」转向「实施者+方案顾问」——设备安装调试、田间校准和农户沟通，是机器替代不了的。懂数据又会修设备的技术员反而更值钱。

大模型辅助生成施肥施药方案
ai_s2_auto: 遥感影像自动解译与长势分析
处方图算法一键生成
数据报表与台账电子化

ai_s3_list: 田间设备调试：RTK 架设、信号校准，故障现场排查。
农艺判断：处方图再准，也要结合地力与农时判断。
与农户的沟通信任：技术讲得懂、听得进，方案才落地。
突发情况的应变：设备失灵、天气突变，田间处置靠人。
数据与生产的结合：图出得再好，也要到地里验证效果。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有一半以上的桌面任务正被自动化——影像解译、处方生成、报表整理，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「出图」环节，留下的是「实施」环节——设备安装、田间校准和农户服务反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯数据处理岗，会修设备、能下田的技术员更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选农学、遥感、地理信息或机电专业，多参加无人机与 GIS 竞赛，假期去农服公司和农机企业实习，把设备和软件两头都练起来。
把无人机、GIS 和 AI 工具用熟，主动承担方案设计与农户培训。从「装设备」升级为「设备+数据+农艺」三合一，考无人机驾驶证和测绘证书。
有遥感、GIS 或机电背景最好，无背景可从设备安装助理切入。简历上多写「装过哪些系统、飞过多少架次、出过哪些处方图」。
招技术员别只看证书，要看下田意愿和服务能力。能修设备、能跑田里、又能跟农户把方案讲明白的候选人，是最稀缺的组合。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help write lesson plans and generate observation records, but when a child cries, the hand reaching out still has to be yours.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 555,100 education teachers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 578,100 by 2034, a net increase of about 23,000 jobs, with about 65,500 openings annually and median annual pay of about $37,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace preschool teachers, but it will take over desk work. Lesson-plan templates, observation records, parent notices, and activity plans can now receive AI-generated first drafts in minutes. Comforting children, reading emotions, resolving conflicts, playing, and talking all require a person to be present and cannot be replaced by machines.
ai_s2_accel: AI speech transcription assists with classroom and meeting notes
Digital child-development assessment scales with automatic summaries of observation data
Family-school communication assistant: AI helps draft wording while people make the judgments
AI search in teaching-resource libraries instantly matches picture books and game plans to a theme
ai_s2_auto: Lesson and activity planning: AI quickly creates a framework for a given theme
First drafts of observation records and development portfolios: AI organizes dictated notes into written form
Bulk generation of parent notices, weekly reports, and holiday card copy
Digital attendance and health records
ai_s3_list: Real-time observation and emotional assessment: an experienced teacher can immediately tell who seems different today and which children have had a conflict.
Organizing the classroom and daily routines: machines cannot set the pace and maintain order among thirty children.
Trust-based communication with parents: explaining a child's bump or fall and easing a parent's anxiety requires tact and sincerity.
Improvisational teaching: a teacher can turn a child's unexpected question into a good lesson on the spot.
Safety and emergency response: bumps, choking, and fever require immediate hands-on skill and judgment.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that desk work accounts for a meaningful share of this occupation. AI tools are rapidly taking over lesson plans, records, notices, and logs, saving substantial time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: However, moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI frees teachers from paperwork so they can return that time to children, improving the quality of attention parents value most. Roles limited to passive supervision with no observation or documentation face the greatest pressure, while teachers who use AI for curriculum development become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: While studying early childhood education, do more than music and movement. Build strong foundations in child development psychology and observation records. In the AI era, understanding children is scarcer than playing piano, so collect case-observation work during internships.

Treat AI as a curriculum assistant: use it for lesson plans, weekly reports, and observation records, and spend the saved time on classroom engagement and family communication. Also monitor changes in teacher-child ratio policies and plan early for professional titles and director credentials.

Childcare experience or an education background is an advantage. First earn a teaching credential, and describe concrete experience on your resume, such as independently leading a class, maintaining observation records, or handling XX types of emergencies. That is more useful than simply saying you like children.

Do not hire based only on certificates; assess situational awareness. Ask candidates to design an activity and simulate resolving a child conflict during the interview to screen out those who only recite theory. Teachers who document observations and write family feedback deserve stronger compensation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你写好教案、生成观察记录，但孩子哭的时候伸过来的那只手，还得是你的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 55.51 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 57.81 万人，净增约 2.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 6.55 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代学龄前教师，但会抢走「案头活」。教案模板、观察记录、家长通知、活动方案，这些现在几分钟就能让 AI 生成初稿。剩下的哄孩子、判断情绪、处理冲突、陪玩陪聊，全是人在场的活，机器替代不了。

ai_s3_list: 对孩子的现场观察与情绪判断：谁今天不对劲、谁和谁起了冲突，一眼能看出来。
课堂与一日生活的组织力：三十个孩子里带节奏、控场面，机器做不到。
与家长的信任沟通：孩子磕碰了怎么解释、怎么让家长放下焦虑，靠的是话术和诚意。
即兴教学应变：孩子一个突发问题，能顺着现场把它变成一节好课。
安全与应急处理：磕碰、呛噎、发烧，第一时间的手上功夫和判断。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的案头比重不低——教案、记录、通知、台账，这些正被 AI 工具快速接管，能省下不少时间。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 把老师从文书里解放出来，省下的时间正好回到孩子身上——这恰恰是家长最看重的「陪伴质量」。真正被挤压的是「零观察、零记录、纯看孩子」的岗位，会借 AI 做教研的老师反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读学前教育专业时别只练弹唱跳，把儿童发展心理学和观察记录学扎实。AI 时代，能「看懂孩子」比会弹钢琴更稀缺，实习时多攒个案观察作品。
把 AI 当成教研助理：写教案、出周报、整理观察记录都用起来，把省下的时间花在教室里的陪伴和家园沟通上。同时留意师幼比政策变化，早规划职称与园长证。
有带娃经验或教育背景是加分项。先把教师资格证拿下，简历里多写「能独立带班、会做观察记录、处理过XX类突发状况」这类具体事，比一句「我喜欢孩子」有用。
招人别只看证书，要看现场感。面试时让候选人现场设计一个活动、模拟处理一次孩子冲突，能筛掉只会背理论的人。会做观察记录、会写家园反馈的老师值得高配。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 16,100 recreational therapists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 16,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with about 1,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $60,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace recreational therapists. Leading activities requires in-person energy and interaction, observing patients' conditions depends on a therapist's clinical sensitivity, and adapting plans is built on long-term trust. AI can help with scheduling, documentation, and assessment forms, but machines cannot take patients through the activities themselves.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted emotion recognition for participation analysis

ai_s2_auto: Automated therapy scheduling and appointment management

ai_s3_list: In-person observation: reading a patient's condition from subtle details.
Activity leadership: energizing the group and encouraging participation.
Personalized design: adapting the same activity to each individual.
Empathetic communication: responding to patients' emotions and resistance.
Cross-team collaboration: working effectively with healthcare staff and families.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates that recreational therapy is a relationship-centered occupation with moderately high AI exposure. Therapy depends on in-person interaction, emotional observation, and long-term trust. AI currently assists only with scheduling, documentation, and data analysis; it cannot replace the core work of leading activities and understanding people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean the field will remain unchanged. AI emotion recognition and VR rehabilitation activities are entering the profession. Therapists who use digital tools for assessment and tracking can deliver more complete, measurable treatment plans and earn greater recognition from institutions.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you want to pursue this path, consider a major related to rehabilitation therapy or psychology while building experience in activity coordination and volunteer work. Make it clear that awareness of this profession is still growing in China and jobs are unevenly distributed, so cities with strong hospital or senior care industries are the best choices.

Shift toward assessment-driven practice. Build strong functional assessment and documentation skills, which distinguish you from a general activities coordinator. Also learn digital assessment tools to present treatment progress quantitatively to the team and management.

People with backgrounds in social work, early childhood education, or nursing can transition relatively smoothly. In China, related roles are often called activity therapist or rehabilitation activities therapist. In interviews, emphasize activity coordination experience and observational documentation skills; a rehabilitation or psychology background is an advantage.

Avoid the misconception that simply knowing how to lead activities is enough. Hiring should prioritize assessment and documentation skills. Providing therapists with digital assessment tools and clear advancement paths helps retain professional talent.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于不变：AI 情绪识别、VR 康复活动正在进入行业，会用数字化工具做评估追踪的治疗师，能提供更完整、可量化的治疗方案，也更受机构认可。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路，建议选康复治疗学或心理学相关专业，同时多积累活动组织和志愿者经验。要跟孩子说清楚：国内这行认知度还在提升，岗位分布不均衡，最好选医院或康养产业发达的城市。
往「评估驱动」转型：把功能评估和文书做扎实，这是你区别于普通活动员的核心竞争力。同时学数字化评估工具，把治疗过程量化呈现给团队和管理层。
有社工、幼教、护理背景的转行相对顺。国内对应岗位多叫「活动治疗/康复活动师」，面试时突出活动组织经验和观察记录能力，有康复或心理学背景更占优。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 19,500 recreational vehicle service technicians were employed in 2024, rising to a projected 21,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 2,200 jobs, with approximately 2,800 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $50,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace recreational vehicle service technicians. RV repair is physical work involving hands-on disassembly, sequential checks, and field testing, with highly varied faults. AI can search manuals, assist diagnosis, and find parts, reducing wasted time, but people still make final judgments and repairs.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted diagnostic trouble code analysis
AR remote expert guidance
Digital electrical-system testing
Upgraded intelligent diagnostic equipment
ai_s2_auto: Digital work-order scheduling and parts searches
Electronic repair manual search
Electronic maintenance records
Automated test-data recording
ai_s3_list: Cross-system troubleshooting: locate combined water, electrical, and gas faults.
Hands-on repair: disassembly skills in confined spaces.
Safety judgment: manage gas and high-voltage electrical risks.
Broad knowledge: combine automotive, plumbing, electrical, refrigeration, and electronics expertise.
Customer communication: explain repair solutions to owners.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means RV service is a hands-on technical role with low-to-moderate AI exposure. Manuals, parts, and diagnostic assistance become digital, while disassembly, repair, and field tuning depend on people. AI searches information and people perform repairs, so near-term replacement risk is low; the main risk is insufficient breadth of skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not allow workers to stop learning. As RV systems become more electronic, technicians should read fault codes, use diagnostic equipment, and understand electronic controls. Upgrading from mechanical repairer to intelligent RV technician creates a major difference in peak-season capacity.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Students in automotive or electromechanical programs can consider the RV niche. The industry is growing, competition is lower than traditional auto repair, and broad skills are rewarded. Build foundations in plumbing, electrical work, refrigeration, and electronics, and intern at an RV manufacturer or repair shop during school breaks.

Learn all six major RV systems: water, electrical, gas, air conditioning, generator, and chassis. Earn electrical and refrigeration certificates and expand into customization and after-sales management. Take customization jobs in peak season and perform preparation and maintenance in slow season for healthier income.

People with automotive, plumbing, electrical, or refrigeration backgrounds have clear advantages. Add RV-specific systems knowledge and begin in an after-sales workshop. Emphasize combined water, electrical, and gas capabilities and field troubleshooting cases rather than simply saying you repair vehicles.

RV repair talent is difficult to recruit and slow to develop, so build an apprenticeship system. Hire beginners with automotive backgrounds, systematically teach RV water, electrical, and gas systems, provide strong diagnostic equipment, and retain workers through combined-skill allowances + customization commissions.

ai_s7_trends: Growing RV fleets sustain after-sales repair demand.
RV electrification and intelligence require technicians to understand electronic controls.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于能止步：房车系统越来越电子化，学会读故障码、用诊断设备、懂电控系统，从「机械修理工」升级成「智能房车技师」，旺季接单能力完全不同。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 汽修/机电专业的孩子可以考虑房车细分：行业在增长、竞争比传统汽修小，综合技能越全越吃香。建议先把水电、制冷、电子的底子打牢，寒暑假去房车厂或维修厂实习，比只学理论强得多。
把房车六大系统（水电燃气空调发电机底盘）学全，考电工、制冷相关证书；往改装业务和售后管理延伸，旺季接改装单、淡季做整备保养，收入结构更健康。
有汽修、水电或制冷背景的转房车维修优势明显：补学房车专项系统，从售后车间做起；求职时突出水电燃气综合能力和现场排故案例，别只说「会修车」。
房车维修人才难招、培养慢，建议自建学徒体系：招汽修背景的新人，系统性带教房车水电燃气，配好诊断设备；用「综合技能津贴 + 改装提成」留人，旺季才有保障。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machines are becoming smarter and can guide stitching automatically, but your hand is still needed when thread breaks or material jams, and your eyes must still identify defective pieces.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 4,100 shoe machine operators and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 3,900 by 2034, a net decrease of about 200 jobs, with approximately 400 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $38,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace shoe machine operators, but it will change how they work. Systems and AI are taking over production statistics, parameter records, and initial quality screening, shifting operators from machine watchers to equipment managers. Material alignment, the feel of stitching, fault assessment, and coordination across multiple processes cannot be replaced by machines. Operators who can adjust machinery and understand multiple processes have greater stability.
ai_s2_accel: As automated production lines spread, single-process roles decline
Intelligent sewing machines automatically adjust tension
AI visual inspection identifies defects in real time
Predictive equipment maintenance reduces downtime

Digital equipment parameter settings

ai_s3_list: The feel of material loading and alignment: shoe materials vary in thickness, softness, and hardness, so alignment depends on experience.
Stitching and sole-pressing craftsmanship: machines cannot independently ensure straight seams and secure sole attachment.
On-site fault judgment: respond immediately to broken thread, material jams, and temperature anomalies.
Tactile quality judgment: human eyes detect subtle defects beyond automated inspection.
Multi-process coordination: people who know several processes can fill gaps on the production line.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means most work occurs beside machines, leaving few desk-based actions that algorithms can standardize. The main examples are peripheral tasks such as output statistics and parameter records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: A low score does not guarantee safety. The occupation's greatest variable is the automated production line itself. As machines become smarter, fewer single-process operators are needed. Workers who can adjust machinery, understand multiple processes, and work with new equipment have real stability, while roles that only watch machines are contracting.

ai_s5_persona.建议: This occupation has a low entry threshold but also a low ceiling, making it suitable as a transition. For a longer-term career, learning mechatronic maintenance or apparel engineering skills during school offers better prospects than pure operation.

Develop multi-process skills and proactively learn machine adjustment, die changes, and basic maintenance. Advance from watching one machine to understanding the entire line, then pursue machine setter or team leader roles.

The low entry threshold and quick training make this suitable for rapid transition. For greater stability, prioritize well-regulated factories with high automation and learn equipment maintenance, which is more valuable than pure operation.

Do not recruit operators solely for speed; assess multi-process capability and reliability. Workers who can adjust machinery, cover multiple stations, and willingly learn new equipment are most needed during automation transitions.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但低分不等于安全。这个职业最大的变数是自动化产线本身——机器越聪明，单一工序操作岗越少。真正稳的是会调机、懂多工序、能配合新设备的操作员，纯「盯着转」的岗位在收窄。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 这是门槛低但天花板也低的工种，适合作为过渡。想长期做，读书期间学机电维修、服装工程相关技能，比纯操作更有出路。
把多工序技能练起来，主动学调机、换模和设备基础维护。从「看一台机」升级为「懂整条线」，往调机员、班组长发展。
门槛低、上手快，适合快速过渡。想稳一点，优先选自动化程度高、用工规范的厂，学设备维护比纯操作值钱。
招操作员别只看速度，要看多工序能力和稳定性。能调机、能顶多个工位、又愿意学新设备的工人，是自动化转型期最需要的。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can produce project reports quickly and comprehensively, but a service manager still has to go into the community to discover that what this older adult truly needs is someone to sit with them for half an hour each week.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 219,800 social and community service managers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 233,900 by 2034, a net increase of about 14,100 jobs, with about 18,600 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $78,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace social and community service managers, but it will take over paperwork and data tasks. Tools can accelerate first drafts of project applications, statistical reports, recordkeeping, and report writing. The real value lies in integrating resources, assessing needs, and leading teams. Clients are individuals, and their needs are complex and dynamic, so only people can connect with and understand them.
ai_s2_accel: Analyzing community needs data to support decisions
Online service application and tracking platforms
AI-assisted case assessment and risk alerts
Digital volunteer recruitment and scheduling
ai_s2_auto: Generating first drafts of project applications and reports
Automating service records and data reporting
Rapidly creating event materials and notification copy
Digitally managing client records
ai_s3_list: Needs assessment: identifying genuine service needs through visits and conversations.
Resource integration: bringing government, foundations, businesses, and communities together around a common goal.
Team leadership: keeping frontline social workers motivated despite low pay and high pressure.
On-site response: handling unexpected client situations flexibly.
Relationship management: maintaining trust with clients, funders, and the community.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 indicates that social service management is in a stage where AI is reshaping the paperwork side of the job. Applications, reports, records, and other writing and data tasks are becoming far more efficient. But the essence of service is human connection. AI can assist with identifying needs, coordinating resources, and managing teams, but it cannot replace people in these areas.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure creates an opportunity. AI frees managers from paperwork so they can focus on the scarcer skills of securing resources, leading teams, and building a strong reputation. Organizations that use AI for reports and data can devote the savings to serving more people, creating a competitive advantage.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Social work is a strong field, but expect a gradual start. Entry-level pay is low, and advancement depends on accumulated experience. Encourage your child to intern at an organization first and decide whether they can accept the routine details and pay level of service work before committing. A social worker credential and a master's degree are major assets for advancement.

Systematize your project management methods, earn an intermediate or advanced social worker credential, and learn digital tools that reduce paperwork. Build a combined skill set in projects, fundraising, and evaluation, then move toward organizational management and away from frontline administrative tasks.

People with backgrounds in administration, HR, or project management have an advantage when transitioning into social services. First study social work theory and earn a social worker credential. In job applications, emphasize what you have organized and which resources you have coordinated. Organizations trust this more than statements about passion alone.

Low pay is the main reason talent leaves the field. Retain staff through career development paths, supervisory support, and flexible arrangements. Equip managers with AI writing tools so staff time can shift to service delivery and fundraising, producing stronger project outcomes.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年社会与社区服务经理在岗约 21.98 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.39 万人，净增约 1.41 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.86 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.82 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代社会与社区服务经理，但会接管文书与数据：项目申报初稿、统计报表、台账管理、报告撰写都能被工具提速。真正的价值在资源整合、需求判断和团队带领——服务对象是具体的人，需求是复杂且动态的，这些只能靠人去对接和感受。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明社会服务管理正处于「文书端被 AI 重构」的阶段：申报、报告、台账这些文字和数据工作大幅提效。但服务的本质是「人对人」，需求识别、资源协调、团队管理这些环节，AI 只能辅助、无法替代。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中位曝光是机会：AI 把经理从文书里解放出来，正好把精力投向更稀缺的「筹资源、带团队、做口碑」。会用 AI 写报告、做数据的机构，省下的预算能多服务更多对象，这就是竞争力。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 社会工作是好专业但要有「慢热」预期：一线起薪低、成长靠积累。建议孩子先在机构实习感受，确认能接受服务行业的琐碎和收入水平再定方向；社工证和硕士学历是晋升硬通货。
把项目管理方法系统化，考取社工师中级/高级证书，同时学数字化工具减轻文书负担。往「项目 + 筹款 + 评估」复合能力走，向机构管理层发展，摆脱一线琐事。
有行政、HR、项目管理背景的人转型社工服务有优势，先补社会工作理论并考社工证。求职时突出「你组织过什么、协调过哪些资源」，比单纯讲情怀更让机构信任。
行业低薪是人才流失主因，建议用「职业发展路径 + 督导支持 + 弹性安排」留人。给管理岗配 AI 文书工具，把人力省下来做服务和筹款，项目成效会更好看。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 164,200 education teachers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 161,500 by 2034, a net decrease of about 2,700 jobs, with about 11,100 openings each year on average. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $69,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace secondary school special education teachers, but it will become a valuable assistant for lesson preparation and documentation. AI can generate differentiated instructional materials and help organize IEP data, freeing teachers from paperwork and returning time to teaching. Classroom management, emotional support, and real-time judgment in individualized instruction cannot be replaced by AI. Special education teachers have long been in short supply, making qualified professionals even more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means lesson preparation and documentation in this occupation are becoming digital. AI can help with teaching materials, IEP organization, and student learning data.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. AI supports paperwork and materials, while classroom instruction, emotional intervention, and family-school communication still depend on teachers. Special education teachers have long been in short supply, making professional, methodical, and compassionate teachers even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study special education, education, or psychology and earn a teaching certificate. Intern at both special education schools and resource classrooms to determine whether you genuinely enjoy and can handle the work.

Use AI lesson-planning and IEP tools to reduce administrative burden, then devote the saved time to instruction and intervention. Develop toward resource teacher or special education curriculum specialist roles and earn professional credentials.

An education or psychology background is ideal. You can enter as a special education assistant or shadow teacher. On your resume, specify the types of students you have taught, interventions you have delivered, and whether you have IEP experience.

Special education teachers are scarce, difficult to recruit, and difficult to retain. Provide adequate allowances, training, and psychological support so strong teachers do not leave because of pressure.

ai_s7_trends: AI-assisted lesson preparation and IEP documentation become widespread, reducing paperwork and returning time to classroom instruction and individualized intervention.
Special and inclusive education policies advance, while special education teachers remain in long-term shortage. Professional, methodical, and compassionate teachers are in greater demand.
AAC and remote inclusive education tools become widespread, shifting special education teachers toward a combined role of instruction, intervention, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

body: Secondary school special education teachers provide individualized instruction and support to students with special educational needs. They develop and implement IEPs, teach academic and life skills, provide emotional and behavioral interventions, communicate with families and schools, and coordinate resources.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can help generate differentiated lesson plans and organize IEP records, but when a student's emotions surge, the teacher still has to kneel down and respond to the frustration behind the words, 'Teacher, I can't do this.'

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你生成分层教案、整理 IEP 记录，但孩子情绪上来的那一瞬间、那一声「老师我不会」背后的沮丧——还得你蹲下来接住。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年教育教师在岗约 16.42 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 16.15 万人，岗位净减约 0.27 万个，年均产生约 1.11 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.96 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代中学特教老师，但会成为备课和记录的好帮手。AI 能生成分层教学材料、辅助 IEP 数据整理，把老师从文书工作里解放出来，把时间还给教学本身。课堂管理、情绪疏导和个别化教学的临场判断，是 AI 替代不了的——特教师资长期短缺，专业老师反而更抢手。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助评估学习障碍
辅助沟通设备（AAC）普及
情绪识别工具辅助观察
远程融合教育与家长平台
ai_s2_auto: AI 生成分层教学课件
IEP 记录自动整理
学情数据电子化分析
教学资源智能推荐
ai_s3_list: 课堂情绪干预：孩子情绪上来，第一时间接得住。
个别化教学的设计：一个孩子一套方法，因材施教。
家校沟通的信任：让家长理解、配合、不放弃。
行为观察与判断：问题行为背后的原因，看得出。
跨专业协作：与心理、康复、家长一起发力。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业的备课与记录环节正在被数字化——课件、IEP 整理、学情数据，AI 都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 辅助的是「文书和材料」环节，课堂教学、情绪干预、家校沟通依然靠老师。特教师资长期短缺，专业、有方法、有爱心的老师反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选特殊教育、教育学或心理学专业，考教资。实习一定要去特教学校和资源教室，看看自己是否真喜欢、扛得住。
把 AI 备课和 IEP 工具用起来，减负后把时间花在教学与干预上。往资源教师、特教教研员方向发展，考取专业证书。
有教育或心理背景最好，可从特教助教或影子老师切入。简历上多写「带过什么类型的孩子、做过哪些干预、有没有 IEP 经验」。
特教老师稀缺，招人难留人难。给足津贴、培训和心理支持，别让好老师因压力流失。

ai_s7_trends: AI 辅助备课与 IEP 记录普及，特教老师从文书工作中减负，把时间还给课堂教学与个别化干预。
特殊教育与融合教育政策推进，特教师资长期短缺，专业、有方法、有爱心的老师更抢手。
AAC 与远程融合教育工具普及，特教老师向「教学+干预+跨专业协作」复合角色转变。

body: 中学特教老师面向有特殊教育需求的中学生开展个别化教学与支持，负责制定与执行 IEP、实施学业与生活技能教学、情绪行为干预，以及家校沟通与资源协调。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你生成分层教案、整理 IEP 记录，但孩子情绪上来的那一瞬间、那一声「老师我不会」背后的沮丧——还得你蹲下来接住。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can generate ten thousand pronunciation exercises, but a therapist still has to coax out the one sound a child is willing to make today.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 187,400 speech-language pathologists were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 215,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 28,100 jobs, with about 13,300 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $95,400 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace speech-language pathologists, but it will reduce their administrative burden. AI can assist with assessments, generate training materials, and support teletherapy platforms, giving therapists more time with students and patients. What it cannot replace is immediate feedback during therapy, diagnostic judgment, and therapeutic relationships built over time.
ai_s2_accel: AI speech analysis for pronunciation assessment
Teletherapy and AI practice tools
Intelligent recommendations for personalized therapy plans
Speech recognition to support swallowing and voice monitoring
ai_s2_auto: Digital assessment scales and automated scoring
Bulk generation of therapy materials and exercises
First drafts of assessment and therapy reports
Automatic recording of rehabilitation progress data
ai_s3_list: Diagnosis and treatment planning: Determining the type of disorder and what to address first requires professional judgment.
Immediate adjustments during therapy: When a child is not responding well, the therapist must change approaches faster than AI.
Therapeutic relationships and trust: Helping patients feel willing to speak depends on trust built over time.
Family and team collaboration: A family's follow-through determines half the success of rehabilitation.
Clinical ethics and responsibility: People remain accountable for misdiagnosis, promises, and professional boundaries.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means part of this occupation consists of desk-based and standardized work. AI is accelerating assessments, material creation, and report writing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. As tools become widespread, professional judgment in diagnosis and treatment design becomes more valuable. Formulaic therapy that merely applies templates will face pressure, while therapists who can diagnose and personalize care will become even scarcer.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study speech and hearing rehabilitation or rehabilitation medicine; a master's degree is the common entry threshold. Develop expertise in areas such as pediatric speech, swallowing, or voice. In the AI era, professionals who can interpret assessment data and understand rehabilitation techniques will be in greatest demand.
Use AI speech analysis and teletherapy tools to save time on report writing. Build deep expertise in aging-related fields such as swallowing and aphasia, where demand and bargaining power are strong.

People from rehabilitation, special education, or nursing backgrounds have advantages when transitioning, but need relevant academic training and professional credentials. Start as a therapist or assessment assistant at an organization, and describe the disorders treated and outcomes achieved on your resume rather than offering vague statements about compassion.

Assess candidates' evaluation reasoning and case design when hiring therapists. Present a case and ask how they would develop a plan. Credentialed candidates with a specialty who can use AI tools merit higher compensation.

ai_s7_trends: AI speech analysis and teletherapy are becoming widespread, greatly improving efficiency in assessment and guided practice.
Demand for pediatric language services and swallowing rehabilitation for older adults is rising, increasing the value of specialized therapists.
Therapists are shifting from manual one-on-one training toward assessment design and data tracking.

body: Speech-language pathologists assess and treat speech, language, swallowing, voice, and fluency disorders. They develop and deliver rehabilitation programs for children and adults and hold specialized clinical roles within rehabilitation medicine.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can generate ten thousand pronunciation exercises, but a therapist still has to coax out the one sound a child is willing to make today.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能生成一万条发音练习，但那个孩子今天愿意张嘴叫出的那一声，还得治疗师哄出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年言语语言病理师在岗约 18.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 21.55 万人，净增约 2.81 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.33 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.54 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代言语语言病理师，但会减轻案头负担。评估辅助、训练素材生成、远程康复平台都能让 AI 代劳，治疗师把时间还给学生和患者。真正无法替代的，是训练中的即时反馈、诊断判断和长期建立的治疗关系。
ai_s2_accel: AI 语音分析辅助发音评估
远程康复与 AI 陪练工具
个性化训练方案的智能推荐
语音识别辅助吞咽与嗓音监测
ai_s2_auto: 评估量表的数字化与自动计分
训练素材与练习的批量生成
评估与训练报告的初稿撰写
康复进度数据的自动记录
ai_s3_list: 诊断与方案设计：障碍类型怎么定、练什么先练什么，是专业判断。
训练中的即时调整：孩子状态不对，换招的速度要比 AI 快。
治疗关系与信任：让患者愿意开口，靠的是长期建立的信任。
家庭与团队协作：家属的执行力，决定康复一半的成败。
临床伦理与责任：误诊、承诺、边界，都是人在把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一部分工作在案头和标准化环节——评估、素材、报告，这些正在被 AI 加速。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：工具越普及，诊断和训练设计的专业判断越值钱。被挤压的是只套模板、不做判断的流水线式训练，会诊断、能个性化的治疗师反而更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读言语听力康复学、康复医学方向，硕士是主流门槛。把儿童言语、吞咽、嗓音等专项方向学好，AI 时代会看评估数据、又懂康复技术的人才最抢手。
把 AI 语音分析和远程康复工具用起来，把时间从写报告里省出来。往吞咽、失语等高龄方向深耕，市场需求大、议价力强。
康复、特教、护理背景的转型有优势，需补专业学历与执业资格。从机构治疗师或评估助理做起，简历上写清「处理过什么障碍、效果如何」，比泛泛的爱心有说服力。
招治疗师要考「评估思路 + 个案设计」：给一个病例问怎么定方案。持证、有专项方向、会用 AI 工具的候选人，值得给更高待遇。

ai_s7_trends: AI 语音分析与远程康复普及，评估和陪练环节大幅提效。
儿童语言与老年吞咽康复需求上升，专项治疗师更吃香。
治疗师从「一对一手工训练」转向「评估设计 + 数据跟踪」。

body: 言语语言病理师评估并治疗言语、语言、吞咽、嗓音与流畅性障碍，为儿童和成人制定并执行康复训练方案，是康复医学体系中的专业临床岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能生成一万条发音练习，但那个孩子今天愿意张嘴叫出的那一声，还得治疗师哄出来。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Backend systems can warn of vibration, but technicians still decide which blade needs replacement, how to act at height, and how to handle emergency repairs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), in 2024 about 13,600 wind turbine technicians were employed. By 2034, employment is projected to rise to 20,500, a net gain of about 6,900 jobs, with approximately 2,300 openings each year. For 2026, the median annual wage is about $62,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace wind turbine technicians, but it will reduce standard inspection roles. Condition monitoring and remote diagnostics accelerate routine inspections, shifting technicians from tower rounds toward component replacement at height, on-site decisions, and emergency repairs. People who only perform standard inspections are being displaced, while those who can repair and diagnose become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Intelligent fault localization
Smart spare parts recommendations
Blade-defect detection
Maintenance plan optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated vibration monitoring
Remote condition diagnostics
Inspection drones
Automated work order generation
ai_s3_list: Component replacement at height: steady hands required.
On-site decisions: people determine how to repair.
Unusual-noise assessment: people listen for faults.
Emergency repairs: people handle unexpected events.
Data assessment: people interpret warnings.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means this field role has medium-high exposure. Systems accelerate standard inspections, but people remain essential for work at height and emergency repairs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Medium-high exposure does not mean high risk. Standard inspection tasks are being replaced, not wind-turbine operations and maintenance roles. People who can repair and diagnose become scarcer and more valuable as efficiency improves. Those who only inspect towers without developing deeper skills face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting in mechatronics or renewable energy, build electrical and climbing skills. Pure inspection is shrinking in the AI era, so learn diagnostics early.
Advance from tower inspections to component replacement + technical assessment, and develop data skills and credentials.
Highlight your work-at-height certificate and turbine experience, clearly identifying the wind farms you have supported. Employers value stability and speed.
When hiring, look beyond physical strength and assess tactile skill and judgment. Core staff who can complete emergency repairs independently are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Condition monitoring spreads, reducing inspections.
Work at height and emergency repairs create opportunities.
Technicians skilled in diagnosis and assessment are in greater demand.

body: Wind turbine technicians inspect units, diagnose faults, replace components, and perform preventive maintenance at wind farms. They apply electrical and mechanical skills to keep turbines operating reliably and support continuous wind-power generation.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 后台能预警振动，但哪片叶要换、怎么高空决断、突发怎么抢修，还是技术员定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年风力涡轮机技术员在岗约 1.36 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.05 万人，净增约 0.69 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.26 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代风力涡轮机技术员，但会压缩标准岗。状态监测与远程诊断把常规巡检提速，技术员从「巡塔」挪向「高空换件、现场决断、应急抢修」。真正被挤掉的是只做标准巡检的，能修、会判断的人更值钱。

备件智能推荐
叶片缺陷识别
保养计划优化
ai_s2_auto: 振动自动监测
远程状态诊断
巡检无人机
工单自动生成
ai_s3_list: 高空换件：手要稳。
现场决断：怎么修靠人。
异响判断：毛病靠人听。
应急抢修：突发靠人。
数据研判：预警靠人读。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的现场岗——标准巡检被系统加速，但高空与抢修仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准巡检」动作，不是「风机运维」的岗位。能修、会判断的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只巡塔、不学深挖的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 机电/新能源起步多练电气和登高，AI 时代纯巡检在缩，早点学诊断。
从「巡塔」升级成「能换件 + 研判」，学数据和证书。
突出登高证和机组经验，写清跟过哪些风场。企业看重稳和快。
选人别只看体力，要看手感和判断。能独立抢修的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 状态监测普及，巡检缩。
高空与抢修带来机会。
会诊断研判的技术员更抢手。
